first.rationale: Competitive entry pricing is specifically taking the price-sensitive SMB segment, and prior evidence indicates targeted promotional pricing can lift acquisition and revenue there. I intend a small guarded test pending verification of the prior pricing experiment’s durability, qualification, and margin outcomes; onboarding evidence is also being verified because declining completion may offer a more durable alternative or a necessary guardrail.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified source showed completion up 13%, time-to-value 2.1 days faster, and 30-day retention up 3%, directly addressing the current 4% onboarding-completion decline while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified acquisition lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline, making it unsuitable for the primary objective. Monitor activation and qualified conversion alongside completion and retention.
